note: The ONE release baseline. Every production machine must run `candidate.image` once approved; scripts/release-check.ts compares production with this file and exits non-zero on any drift. Update this file in the same commit as a new release candidate; set `approved` only when the owner approves it.

approved.scope: API and collector on this image (APEX shadow integration, Operations panel 6). No migration. Not approved: worker app, tokens, dummy-secret test, WORKER_API_ENABLED, worker activation, the USX run, APEX on USX, RPC/explorer hosts, monitoring, schema changes, removal of agentsmith_worker, merge to main.
